commit.message:
All 7.0 hipRTC fixes (#3803)

* Add miopen include to set the types for hip kernels

* Add missing  miopen_cstdint includes

* Fix kth value

* Fix reduce issue, not sure about this generally though need to test broadly

* Swap kernels to use a WarpSize constant define as a temporay workaround to see other issues

* Fix warpSize changes

* Workaround softmax constants

* Fix block_reduce

* warp size fixes

* Add const back

* Fix code formatting

* Fix adam test

* Add missing type include

* fix MIOpenGetItem

* Consistency with other hipRTC kernels

* Start converting from warpSize to MIOPEN_WARP_SIZE

* Add missing includes

* Replace uses of warpSize with MIOPEN_WARP_SIZE in static CK

* Reformat code

* Reformat code again

* Add missing kernel includes

* Include miopen_type_traits.hpp instead of type_traits for backwards compatibility

* Use pragma_once instead of an include guard

---------

Co-authored-by: Jonathan Lichtner <195780826+JonathanLichtnerAMD@users.noreply.github.com>

[ROCm/MIOpen commit: 9debb4abb910c6cb5c7ac3c5088abbe1879bcf1b]
